identity.name: Huntington Lakes
identity.notes: Huntington Lakes is a gated residential condo community in Naples, FL (Collier County), established on 11/07/1995. Located at 6900 Huntington Lakes Cir, Naples, FL 34119. Managed by First Service Residential. The community features a clubhouse with multiple amenities, three pools, tennis courts, and a 2-mile walking/biking perimeter.

fees.note: HOA fees are required (listed as 'HOA Required Plus Fees') but specific amounts are not stated in the available content. Contact the property manager (First Service Residential, 954-926-2921) for current fee amounts.

Aggregator-reported 'average HOA fee' for Huntington Lakes condos; not confirmed by the HOA or property manager. Verify with First Service Residential before purchase. A separate unverified snippet (communitypay.us) cited a median fee of $538/mo for the sub-association 'Huntington Lakes Two Condominium Association, Inc.' — page not read, treat as unconfirmed. No CDD special assessment figures found in sources read. (Retrieved 2026-09-15T12:00:00Z, confidence 0.4.)
